create_adaboost_classifier: create an AdaBoost classifier with decision stumps and fit it on concatenated Gaussian quantile datasets
generate_gaussian_quantiles: generate synthetic two-class Gaussian quantile datasets with configurable covariance and sample count
plot_decision_boundary: plot the decision boundary of a fitted AdaBoost classifier on a two-dimensional feature space
visualize_decision_scores: visualize the distribution of decision scores for each class using histograms
scatter_training_points: scatter plot training data points colored by class label with edge outlines
